body:
Your ask: bigger, 2-3 floors as ONE room (no fade between floors), a counter, cozy spots for the pets instead of cages; bear on a sofa watching TV on floor 3.
One open middle (6.4 x 4.6) from floor 1 to the roof, wide stairs: 1 to 2 on the left wall, 2 to 3 on the right. Inside 14 x 10; outside the shop grows to match (14 x 10, 3 floors).
Floor 1: counter with Ms. Paws, shelves, dog sofa + rug, cat window seat + cat tree, bunny + hamster play hill with a big tree growing up through the middle.
Floor 2: capybara warm tub, duck pond with a bridge, owl on a tree branch, a sofa to watch from.
Floor 3 (Big pets): bear on a sofa facing a TV (Cat show now, Izabele's movie later), seal pool with a slide, monkey climbing frame + ropes on the tree.
Picked 31 Oct: all approved (room, building and 10 pieces).

comments.text: Karolis: "all aproved. very good". Sent to Moves.

short: Picked: new Pet Shop, 3 open floors, no cages

title: New Pet Shop: 3 floors, one open room
